Bug_Title: NP: Method with Optional return type returns explicit null (NP_OPTIONAL_RETURN_NULL)
Bug_Details:
The usage of Optional return type (java.util.Optional or com.google.common.base.Optional)
always means that explicit null returns were not desired by design.
Returning a null value in such case is a contract violation and will most likely break client code.
Bug_Explanation: The method getOptionalString has a return type of Optional<String>, but it returns an explicit null when the condition is met. This is a violation of the contract of Optional, which should not return null.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the method showBug with the parameter true, which leads to a call to getOptionalString that returns null instead of an Optional, violating the contract of Optional return type.
